title: Feature Request: Option to disable or customize the "Ctrl+Enter" Send shortcut
creator: hunterlin.ndfai
content:
Dear Thunderbird Development Team,

I am writing to share feedback and request an essential usability improvement regarding keyboard shortcuts in Thunderbird.

While drafting emails, I frequently trigger the Ctrl + Enter shortcut by accident. This causes unfinished emails to be sent out immediately, leading to awkward and unprofessional situations with recipients.

To resolve this issue, I attempted using add-ons such as tbkey-lite to remap or disable the shortcut, but the configuration proved ineffective. As a temporary workaround, I have enabled the "Send Later" / delayed sending feature so I can intercept accidental sends in the Outbox. However, this is only a band-aid solution and remains a constant source of anxiety while typing.

I kindly request that future versions of Thunderbird consider the following improvements: 

   Built-in Shortcut Customization: An option in the settings menu to disable, rebind, or customize global/composer shortcuts (especially Ctrl + Enter). 
   Confirmation Prompt Toggle: A built-in preference to prompt a confirmation dialog before sending (e.g., "Are you sure you want to send this message now?"), which would prevent accidental keystrokes from immediately dispatching drafts.

Thunderbird is a fantastic, privacy-respecting client that I rely on daily. Having better control over critical keyboard shortcuts would significantly improve the writing experience for many users who face the same frustration.

Thank you very much for your time, dedication, and continued hard work on this project.

Best regards,|

Hunter
